title: Distinguished PKS Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems (MPI-PKS)
about: The Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems awards one Distinguished PKS Postdoctoral Fellowship per year: a two-year appointment with a possible one-year extension. The 2027 call is open with an application deadline of 13 November 2026.
requirements: Generally at least one year of postdoctoral experience at an institution other than the one awarding the PhD; applications directly after the PhD only in exceptional cases
Single PDF with cover letter, CV, publication list, research-interest statement and research proposal
Three reference letters via the institute reference portal

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research proposal writing" / "research-interest statement and research proposal" → "research planning, and knowledge synthesis"

"Single PDF with cover letter, CV, publication list, research-interest statement and research proposal" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis"
